scope: Rust runtime metadata contract; consumable by desktop and service tests
rules: Each physical request owns one completed model.attempt record
Usage snapshots replace, never add; model.requested has no token usage
Missing provider usage is unknown, distinct from a reported zero
Failed or truncated requests retain reported usage without authorizing partial tools
Paused/resumed segments use distinct spans of one logical turn and explicit links
A missing completion after process loss is unknown, not zero cost
